verdict.rationale: Granola documents a public RESTful API that gives programmatic access to meeting notes, transcripts and AI summaries. Access uses user API keys with selectable note-access scopes, plus non-expiring workspace API keys on Business and Enterprise plans. Docs pitch it for building custom AI agents and automations. However, the evidence shows the API mainly reads data rather than controlling the product, and no machine-readable spec was found. Missing for 10: documented write/action endpoints (e.g. creating notes or triggering recordings), a published OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404), endpoint-level reference detail, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: The Granola API provides programmatic access to your workspace's meeting notes and related data. This RESTful API enables you to integrate Granola with your existing tools
The Granola API lets you build custom integrations with programmatic access to meeting notes, transcripts, and AI summaries.
When you create an API key, you choose which note access scopes it should include.
Workspace admins on Business and Enterprise plans can also create workspace API keys.
